source_categories.name: Trail Map Archives
source_categories.archive_use: Core historical evidence for lift layout, trail networks, branding, terrain expansion, and dated resort snapshots.

source_categories.name: Historical Aerial Imagery
source_categories.archive_use: Primary geospatial evidence for terrain clearing, lift alignments, base area development, parking expansion, and lost-area remains.

source_categories.name: Ski Museums
source_categories.archive_use: Institutional collections, photographs, artifacts, oral histories, and provenance-rich archival material.

source_categories.name: University Archives
source_categories.archive_use: Finding aids, personal papers, club records, historic photographs, and regional skiing history.

source_categories.name: Regional Historical Archives
source_categories.archive_use: Small-area documentation, local newspaper clippings, brochures, postcards, and community memory.

source_categories.name: Lost Ski Area Research
source_categories.archive_use: Closure dates, remnants, ownership clues, surface lift histories, and defunct-area geographic evidence.

source_categories.name: Digital Repositories
source_categories.archive_use: Cross-institutional discovery of digitized brochures, maps, photographs, film, and publications.

known_gaps: Historical aerial imagery is weak or missing for most resorts.
Ownership and operator history is incomplete.
Lift manufacturer, installation, and removal data is sparse.
Historical boundaries and GIS-ready geometries are mostly absent.
Collection-level provenance is not yet consistently captured.
Rights status and digitization status must be tracked per asset.
site_refinements: Promote Collections and Museums into top-level exploration paths.
Present Historical Snapshot cards on each resort page.
Show coverage status for trail maps, aerials, lifts, ownership, oral histories, and GIS readiness.
Keep trail maps as the lead media experience until aerial coverage improves.
Prepare for synchronized historical map and aerial comparison views.
